text: To accommodate the proposal questions process, Respondents shall submit any such questions by the above due date.

It shall be the Respondent’s responsibility to read the Instructions, Centralina’s terms and conditions, all relevant exhibits and attachments, and any other components made a part of this RFP and comply with all requirements and specifications herein.
Respondents also are responsible for obtaining and complying with all Addenda and other changes that may be issued in connection with this RFP.

If Respondents have questions, issues or exceptions regarding any term, condition, instruction or other component within this RFP, those shall be submitted as questions in accordance with the instructions in Section 2.3 Proposal Questions.

By execution and delivery of a proposal in response to this Request for Proposals, Respondent agrees that any additional or modified terms and conditions, including Instructions to Respondents, whether submitted purposely or inadvertently, or any purported condition to the offer shall have no force or effect, and will be disregarded.
Noncompliance with, or any attempt to alter or delete, this paragraph shall constitute sufficient grounds to reject Respondent’s proposal as nonresponsive.

If a Respondent desires modification of the terms and conditions of this solicitation, it is urged and cautioned to inquire during the question period, in accordance with the instructions in Section 2.3
Identification of objections or exceptions to Centralina’s terms and conditions in the proposal itself shall not be allowed and shall be disregarded or the proposal rejected.

During the evaluation period—from the date proposals are submitted through the date the contract is awarded—each Respondent submitting a proposal (including its representatives, sub-contractors and/or suppliers) is prohibited from having any communications with any person inside or outside the using agency
A Respondent not in compliance with this provision shall be disqualified from contract award
A Respondent’s proposal may be disqualified if its sub-contractor and supplier engage in any of the foregoing communications during the time that the procurement is active
Therefore, all proposals should be complete and reflect the most favorable terms available from the Respondent.
Prices proposal cannot be altered or modified as part of a clarification.
Any Respondent determined to be technically unqualified, or whose submittal is deemed unresponsive, will not be considered.
By submitting a Proposal, the Respondent agrees to meet all stated requirements in this Section as well as any other specifications, requirements and terms and conditions stated in this RFP.

If a Respondent is unclear about a requirement or specification or believes a change to a requirement would allow for Centralina to receive a better proposal, the Respondent is urged and cautioned to submit these items in the form of a question during the question and answer period

Items identified as required for the RFP response should be addressed in the respondent’s submittal.
Centralina expects the Vendor to address at a minimum the following tasks.
1.1 Continuous monitoring of the organization’s IT environment for security threats
1.2 Full visibility into the endpoint landscape with reduced attack surface from unknown or unmanaged assets.
1.3 Standard monthly Microsoft Patch Schedule for remediation of Microsoft vulnerabilities
1.4 Monthly updates of third-party software vulnerabilities.
1.5. Enable governance and visibility by enforcing control, accountability, and traceability across endpoint systems.
1.6 Proactive security posture management backed by measurable and actionable insights.
2.1 Promptly acknowledge incoming incidents and requests via ticketing systems, phone, email, or chat.
2.2 Deliver timely issue response and resolution in accordance with established service level agreements.
2.3 A consistently positive end‑user experience that reinforces trust in IT services.
2.4 Standardized service delivery resulting in fewer repeat incidents and continual service improvement.
2.5 Deliver end user support for common business applications: Microsoft Windows, M365, SharePoint, VOIP services, mobile devices, MacOS and printing.
3.1 Ensure continuous cloud backup coverage for Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and servers in alignment with defined service level and data retention requirements.
3.2 Documented and actionable recovery plans that support rapid system restoration.
4.1 Offer network firewalls, switches, wireless access points, UPS units, and rack management solutions available via lease or direct purchase.
4.2 Proactively observe network devices, connectivity, and services to quickly detect performance degradation, outages, or capacity constraints.
4.3 Reduce network-based security risks and improve overall security posture.
4.4 Deliver stakeholder notifications for service degradation or outages within SLA specified time thresholds, aligned to incident severity and business impact.
5.1 Deliver monthly cybersecurity training modules to increase user knowledge and awareness of cybersecurity risks.
5.2 Provide reporting and dashboard capabilities to track user engagement and participation.
6.1 Clear visibility into service performance and measurable operational accountability.
6.2 Proactive identification of issues before they impact service delivery or client operations.
6.3 Technology alignment that supports client growth, security, and scalability.
6.4 Continuous service improvement and closure of identified gaps.
Respondents are requested to propose a detailed project timeline and recommend sequencing tasks based on their professional judgment and experience.
